description: Open a private Fudge draft to build in directly. Fudge copies the live theme into a draft with its own preview. Give a short title and the storefront `page`, or `work` to continue existing work. `requestId` makes retries create one draft. Use for precise changes you make yourself; needs a Fudge plan that includes building.

page.description: Storefront path the work is about, e.g. /products/blue-runner, /collections/sale or /pages/about. Anchors the preview. Defaults to the home page.

requestId.description: A unique ID you choose for this request, e.g. a UUID. Retries reuse it.

store.description: The connected store to use. Omit when only one is connected.

title.description: Short merchant-facing name for the work, e.g. “Size guide on product pages”.

work.description: A fudge://project/… ref to continue instead of starting new work.

name: start_draft
title: Start draft
